title: As a child he sensed the tube TV turning on from another room

tellings.quote: I would always know when the TV was on because when my dad would

plain: As a boy, Dan Sherman always knew when the old tube television had been turned on in another room, he says, sensing it when his father switched it on. Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA, the US intelligence agency that intercepts communications, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells this about himself. He offers it as an early sign of the unusual sensitivity he says he had.
